japan/131-exacta-category-b1-v1.data: development race days only (is_holdout_day False, filtered before any outcome, odds or dividend is read); races from 2014-06-07 that have #114 out-of-fold Win probabilities, i.e. its walk-forward test quarters (from 2020-Q1)
japan/131-exacta-category-b1-v1.estimand: rho_S = sum_r R^B1_{S,r} / sum_r rate_r (null 1); B1 does not use p
exclusions: more than one paying exacta (dead heat for 1st or 2nd)
japan/131-exacta-category-b1-v1.favourite: lowest final Win odds, ties to the lowest number
japan/131-exacta-category-b1-v1.interval: meeting bootstrap of the estimand, 95% one-sided in each direction
japan/131-exacta-category-b1-v1.ordering: discounted Harville; in_fold = #115's lambda2, one fit on the development out-of-fold races (ordering_v0.yaml; the fit id is recorded with each run); 1.0 = plain Harville
japan/131-exacta-category-b1-v1.role: E1' reported variant, not in E1's max test

segments.class: DEBUT, MAIDEN -> maiden; C1-C3 -> win1-3; OP, L, G1-G3 -> open
segments.fav_odds: final Win odds of the favourite: <=1.9, 2.0-2.9, 3.0-4.9, >=5.0
segments.headline: favourite odds >= 3.0 and less popular
segments.popularity: less = race_no 1-4 or a DEBUT/MAIDEN race; rest = every other race

japan/131-exacta-category-b1-v1.win_probabilities: #114 out-of-fold calibrated p_cal, renormalised over the starters
